title: Paradiso Source Evidence Metadata
description: Recommended metadata for official-source support on Paradiso visa/status data and claim-level AI grounding. This schema is advisory and does not force a production data migration.

sourceType.description: Type of source used to support the claim. Internal normalized data is not legal authority unless it links to an official source.

sourceName.description: Human-readable official source title, manual name, law name, notice title, form name, or service page name.

sourceVersionDate.description: Source version, publication date, manual date, or known source month/year.

sourceUrl.description: Official URL when applicable. Do not use unofficial summaries as authority.

sourceLocator.description: Precise locator such as repo file path, URL plus notice id, manual file plus page, law article, form id, table row, or section heading.

sourcePage.description: Printed page, PDF page, or page range when applicable.

sourceSection.description: Section heading, law article, appendix, table title, form section, or page subsection.

sourceQuoteKo.description: Exact Korean quote supporting a high-impact claim, when available.

preciseSectionReference.description: Precise official section, article, table, appendix, or row reference used when an exact quote is unavailable.

supportLevel.description: Relationship between the source and the exact claim.

reviewerNotes.description: Reviewer explanation of what was verified, scope limits, caveats, and remaining gaps.

lastChecked.description: Date the official source support was last checked.
